## Product Overview

HoneyPezil™ is a premium dietary supplement formulated to provide nutritional support for healthy blood flow, cellular energy production, and everyday vitality. The formula combines carefully selected amino acids and essential nutrients that complement an active lifestyle and support overall wellness.

HoneyPezil™ is manufactured in the USA in an FDA-registered, cGMP-compliant facility using strict quality-control standards. The formula is stimulant-free and Non-GMO.

## Intended Use

HoneyPezil™ is intended for healthy adults seeking nutritional support for:

- Healthy circulation
- Nitric oxide production
- Cellular energy metabolism
- Daily physical vitality
- General wellness

Use only as directed on the product label.

## Supplement Facts (Per 2-Capsule Serving)

- L-Arginine — 250 mg
- L-Arginine AKG 2:1 Extract — 200 mg
- L-Citrulline HCL — 200 mg
- L-Citrulline Malate — 200 mg
- Niacin (Vitamin B3) — 20 mg
- Beta-Alanine — 100 mg

## Ingredient Summary

L-Arginine supports healthy nitric oxide production and normal blood flow.

L-Arginine AKG 2:1 Extract complements arginine availability for circulatory support.

L-Citrulline HCL is converted into arginine in the body to support vascular health.

L-Citrulline Malate supports circulation and cellular energy metabolism.

Niacin (Vitamin B3) contributes to normal energy production and healthy cellular function.

Beta-Alanine supports everyday physical endurance and stamina.
